summary: Phase B (admin image uploads) + Phase C (visual polish of ConfigHomepage) fully verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering public GET /api/homepage (CI+IN), admin list auth-gate, admin CRUD roundtrip (create→patch→GET on public feed→delete), upload auth-gate, non-image rejection (400), and upload+serve roundtrip that verifies returned bytes match uploaded bytes. Frontend desktop CI (1440x900): data-testid=config-homepage present with all Phase C testids — hp-hero-title (‘Tout ce dont vous avez besoin, livré en quelques minutes’), hp-hero-cta, hp-hero-delivery-panel showing 10-15 min / CFA500.00 fee / CFA3000.00 min / free over CFA15000.00 / ‘Côte d’Ivoire’, hp-module-switcher with all 6 tiles (hp-module-mart|food|shop|express|auto|immo), clicking hp-module-express navigated to /express, category tiles rendered as hp-cat-{slug} (fruits-vegetables, dairy-eggs, beverages…) and clicking navigated to /products?category=fruits-vegetables, hp-carousel-prev-{id}+hp-carousel-next-{id} present (scrollLeft went 4→1070 on click), hp-google-play, hp-app-store, hp-cta-strip-link, hp-trust-strip all rendered. Country switch to IN via header country picker: hp-hero-delivery-panel updated to 20-30 min / ₹29.00 fee / ₹199.00 min / free over ₹499.00 / ‘India’. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==viewport==390), hp-hero-delivery-panel + hp-trust-strip present, 0 console errors. Phase B admin upload E2E: logged in as super admin, opened Homepage Management, opened Hero drawer, uploaded a PNG via hidden file input — URL field populated with ‘/api/homepage/uploads/baked-platform/homepage/adm_a61fd…/20260824T140029….png’, ‘Uploaded’ toast displayed. Zero console errors across every scenario. Regression: /admin/homepage-management lists all 10 sections with Edit/Up/Down/Delete/Toggle-Enabled/Add controls.

issues: Currency formatting shows two decimals (CFA500.00, CFA3000.00, ₹29.00, ₹199.00). Review spec called for CFA500 / CFA3000 / ₹29 / ₹199 without decimals for cleaner presentation. formatMoney is producing trailing .00 for whole-number values.

action_items: Add data-testid="admin-email", data-testid="admin-password", data-testid="admin-submit" on the Super Admin login form at /admin/login. The review context lists them as expected testids but they are absent — testing had to fall back to positional input selectors, which is brittle.
Consider tightening formatMoney to drop trailing .00 for whole numbers on the hero delivery panel (CFA500 vs CFA500.00). Cosmetic — matches the spec ask in Phase C.

The review request text referenced testid `hp-cat-baked-platform` but the CI seed does not include a `baked-platform` category slug (actual slugs: fruits-vegetables, dairy-eggs, beverages, …). This is a request-text mismatch, not a bug. If a canonical BAKĒD-branded category tile is desired, add it to the CI category_grid seed.

Verify light-theme toggle actually toggles a class/attribute on <html> — after clicking the theme button, document.documentElement.className remained empty; theme may not be persisting or may only be applied via CSS variables on a lower node. Text remained readable in the screenshot so it may be working via data-theme attribute; worth a quick confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: ConfigHomepage.jsx line 33: `abs()` prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only when URL starts with '/'. Good. But `abs()` is not applied to PromoBanner.cfg.image (line 374) — the CSS `url(${abs(cfg.image)})` DOES call abs, so scratch that; verified OK.

ConfigHomepage.jsx trust strip is hard-coded and always rendered after admin sections. Comment says ‘admin can’t accidentally hide it’ — this is intentional and matches the review spec (‘Trust strip at end’ + ‘persistent’).
modules/homepage/__init__.py upload endpoint is properly auth-gated, image-type validated, 8MB size-limited, and serves back via a public GET. Good pattern.
Admin login page (source not inspected here) is missing the promised data-testid trio — this is a repeat testability gap flagged in earlier iterations.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all functional testids and integrations verified; only cosmetic/testability nits
